items.meaning: For the same rod the proper length is greater than any longitudinal moving-frame length at nonzero speed. Reverse the rest/moving roles of K and K_1: a rod at rest in K has proper length l_0 there and a contracted length in K_1. Reciprocity follows from the relativity principle, not a preferred frame.

items.meaning: The source uses Eddington's common-sense warning and a Gulliver literary comparison to express the puzzling reciprocal character of contraction. Remove the fiction; use a neutral comparison of equal-proper-length rods at rest in different frames, with each frame's own simultaneous endpoint measurements. If naming Eddington, identify him only as the source's historical attribution; do not reattribute new explanatory prose or call the fiction science.
